paragraphs: Friend, here's what I want you to hold onto. Daniel spends three full weeks mourning, and from the first day he set his heart to understand and humble himself, his words were heard (Daniel 10:12). Nothing was lost in the silence. It was just a long wait with a lot going on behind the scenes.

And there WAS a lot going on, friend. The one sent to Daniel says the prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed him for twenty-one days, until Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help (Daniel 10:13). I spent years in the back of a junk drawer thinking nobody heard a thing, and honestly, I was wrong about that too. When it looks quiet from where you're sitting, that doesn't mean nobody is working on it.

Look at how Daniel is treated, too. He's trembling, speechless and out of breath, and he's touched, strengthened and told, "Do not be afraid, you who are highly precious" (Daniel 10:19). So bring your prayers and your questions to God, even when you're shaking like a cookie sheet with one bad leg. He hears you, He strengthens you, and the answer is worth the wait. This is only the start of the vision, so keep your oven warm.
